headline: Knee-high leftovers — barely worth the paddle.
today: About a foot at short period on a fair angle, and cross-on SSE fills in by afternoon. Offshore N at dawn is clean but there's next to nothing on it. Skip unless you're desperate.

daysToWatch.note: Up to 4.3ft but short period and onshore/cross-on all day — sizeable and messy. Manageable but not clean.
Best of the week. Chest-high S at 5s with NNW-to-NE offshore in the morning. Dawn patrol before afternoon cross-on.
